purpose: Teach: 供養/守護/物色/不特定/贈与/再婚/勝訴/虚構

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦死者供養の歴史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the history of war-dead memorialization, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm and observant. Leaning forward slightly. Opening with genuine interest, not quiz-show distance. Measured pace, like she's giving him room to answer.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、地域の守護神信仰を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on local guardian-deity beliefs in my paper.
lines.style: Quiet, careful. Slight pause before answering—checking whether he's said it right. Respectful toward the topic. No false confidence.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、企業が物色する人材の傾向を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you examined what kind of talent companies are looking for in your paper, right?
lines.style: Thoughtful, with a hint of something puzzled underneath. Not quite skeptical, but noticing a mismatch. Gentle redirection.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、不特定多数を狙ったテロの研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, my paper looked at research on indiscriminate mass-targeted terrorism.
lines.style: Steady and direct. No apology in the voice. Standing by the work. Slight firmness on the key term—this matters.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 遺産贈与の法制度を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You addressed inheritance law and gift transfer in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Present and attentive. A touch of genuine inquiry. Not leading—she's actually interested in what he'll say. Slight lift at the end, inviting him in.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦後の再婚率の社会学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, my paper examined postwar remarriage rates through a sociological lens.
lines.style: Controlled but solid. Brief exhale before answering. Not defensive, but aware that the topic shifts meaning. Clear and unbothered.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、市民訴訟で勝訴した事例を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote about a civil-court case that won, didn't you?
lines.style: Reflective, almost gentle. A small pause before 'didn't you'—she's listening, really listening. Inviting but not pressing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、メディアが作り出す虚構を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, my paper focused on how media constructs fiction and illusion.
lines.style: Quiet authority. Finished thought with no trailing off. The answer is complete. Small breath at the end—settling into what he's said.
